titleEn: Minimum Cost to Make at Least One Valid Path in a Grid
title: 使网格图至少有一条有效路径的最小代价
summary: 每个格子箭头指向一个方向，修改一个箭头代价一，求从左上到右下的最小修改次数。
insight: 把每个格子视为图节点：沿原箭头移动的边权为零，其余三个方向边权为一；用 0-1 BFS 求最短路。
pitfalls: 边权取决于离开当前格子的方向
零权边压入双端队列前端
只有距离变小时才更新

solutions.title: 零一广度优先搜索
solutions.idea: 使用双端队列在线性边数内求零一权最短路。
steps: dist 初始化无穷，起点为零并入队
枚举四邻，weight 为方向是否等于 grid[row][col]
松弛后零权 addFirst、一权 addLast；返回终点距离

code.java: class Solution { public int minCost(int[][] grid){int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length;int[][] directions={{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}},dist=new int[rows][cols];for(int[] row:dist)Arrays.fill(row,Integer.MAX_VALUE);Deque<int[]> deque=new ArrayDeque<>();dist[0][0]=0;deque.addFirst(new int[]{0,0});while(!deque.isEmpty()){int[] cell=deque.removeFirst();int row=cell[0],col=cell[1];for(int direction=0;direction<4;direction++){int nextRow=row+directions[direction][0],nextCol=col+directions[direction][1];if(nextRow<0||nextRow>=rows||nextCol<0||nextCol>=cols)continue;int weight=grid[row][col]==direction+1?0:1,newDistance=dist[row][col]+weight;if(newDistance<dist[nextRow][nextCol]){dist[nextRow][nextCol]=newDistance;if(weight==0)deque.addFirst(new int[]{nextRow,nextCol});else deque.addLast(new int[]{nextRow,nextCol});}}}return dist[rows-1][cols-1];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minCost(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val rows=grid.size;val cols=grid[0].size;val directions=arrayOf(intArrayOf(0,1),intArrayOf(0,-1),intArrayOf(1,0),intArrayOf(-1,0));val dist=Array(rows){IntArray(cols){Int.MAX_VALUE}};val deque=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();dist[0][0]=0;deque.addFirst(intArrayOf(0,0));while(deque.isNotEmpty()){val cell=deque.removeFirst();val row=cell[0];val col=cell[1];for(direction in 0..3){val nextRow=row+directions[direction][0];val nextCol=col+directions[direction][1];if(nextRow !in 0 until rows||nextCol !in 0 until cols)continue;val weight=if(grid[row][col]==direction+1)0 else 1;val newDistance=dist[row][col]+weight;if(newDistance<dist[nextRow][nextCol]){dist[nextRow][nextCol]=newDistance;if(weight==0)deque.addFirst(intArrayOf(nextRow,nextCol))else deque.addLast(intArrayOf(nextRow,nextCol))}}};return dist[rows-1][cols-1]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minCost(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),cols=grid[0].size();int directions[4][2]={{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};vector<vector<int>> dist(rows,vector<int>(cols,INT_MAX));deque<pair<int,int>> pending;dist[0][0]=0;pending.push_front({0,0});while(!pending.empty()){auto [row,col]=pending.front();pending.pop_front();for(int direction=0;direction<4;++direction){int nextRow=row+directions[direction][0],nextCol=col+directions[direction][1];if(nextRow<0||nextRow>=rows||nextCol<0||nextCol>=cols)continue;int weight=grid[row][col]==direction+1?0:1,newDistance=dist[row][col]+weight;if(newDistance<dist[nextRow][nextCol]){dist[nextRow][nextCol]=newDistance;if(weight)pending.push_back({nextRow,nextCol});else pending.push_front({nextRow,nextCol});}}}return dist.back().back();} };
